name: gizza-ai/youtube-thumbnail-generator
summary: Generate a thumbnail PNG from a video frame with outlined headline text

tool.description: Generate a YouTube-style thumbnail PNG from a single video frame. Provide a video by url or ref, a headline, optional timestamp, output width/height (default 1280x720), headline position, font size, text and outline colors, and an accent bar color/position/size. The frame is scaled/cropped to the target canvas, a colored accent bar is drawn, and the headline is rendered with a bundled bold font via ffmpeg drawtext using textfile/fontfile (no inline text escaping). Returns a PNG image. Note: runs on the standalone page and CLI; chat ffmpeg is unavailable.

accent_color.description: Accent bar color as a CSS color name or hex. Default #ffcc00.

accent_position.description: Accent bar placement: bottom, top, left, right, or none. Default bottom.

accent_size.description: Accent bar thickness in pixels. Use 0 or accent_position=none to hide it. Default 22.

font_size.description: Headline font size in pixels (16-220). Default 96.

headline.description: Large headline text to draw on the thumbnail. Drawn literally from a text file, so punctuation is safe. Keep it short (max 120 characters).

height.description: Output thumbnail height in pixels. Default 720 (YouTube 16:9).

outline_color.description: Headline outline color as a CSS color name or hex. Default black.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

text_color.description: Headline fill color as a CSS color name or hex (#ffffff, #fc0). Default white.

text_position.description: Where to anchor the outlined headline: bottom, top, or center. Default bottom.

timestamp.description: Seconds into the video to capture the source frame. Default 0.

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

width.description: Output thumbnail width in pixels. Default 1280 (YouTube 16:9).
